pencereler.0-5: USS Thresher was lost during a deep-diving test. It fell past its crush depth,
pencereler.5-12: and all one hundred twenty nine aboard were lost. Investigators believe a pipe joint leaked in the engine room.
pencereler.12-20: The reactor shut down, and the sub lost power. The crew tried an emergency blow of the ballast tanks. Ice formed in
pencereler.20-30: the air system and blocked it. Without that air, Thresher kept sinking. The Navy then created the SUBSAFE programme.

segmentler.metin: USS Thresher was lost during a deep-diving test.
It took only a likely piping leak in the engine room at test depth.
So how could a likely piping leak in the engine room at test depth do this?
The answer is probable flooding from a piping joint, reactor shutdown, and ice blocking the emergency ballast blow — and it is why the US Navy created the SUBSAFE programme for submarine systems.
